digest.component_or_area: LLM usage logging and repetition detector
propositions: max_consecutive_repeat metric only detects back-to-back identical tool call signatures and scores a k-cycle with k>=2 as 1 while scoring healthy breadth-based runs with higher values
a 4-call cycle repeated 31-37 times scores max_consecutive_repeat=1 while a healthy high-novelty run scores 5, inverting the intended signal

proposed windowed distinct-ratio over trailing 24 tool calls (distinct signatures / window size) catches all cycle lengths and separates pathological loops (ratio <= 0.50) from healthy runs (ratio >= 0.833)
new field distinct_ratio_window must be None for sequences shorter than REPETITION_WINDOW=24 to prevent false positives on short prefixes
distinct_ratio_window is added as an additive field to _repetition_summary without changing existing counters or caller contracts
